certificate.convention: per-slot minimum, matching v1 parameter generator; not a transcript-wide union bound
certificate.tensor_fold_bridge: Width-independent interleaved MCA charges each of the three shared-challenge levels once: bad tuple count <=3*E*q^2. Add2*Lambda/q for the unchanged identity term.
certificate.transition_bridge: Incoming combination at target round: 2*(1+t_previous)*L_target/q for one previous OOD claim and t_previous in-domain claims.

certificate.convention: each listed slot is checked separately, matching ProveKit v0.1.1 round-by-round parameter selection

initial_batch_geometry.fold_weights: tensor product of the 2 vector coefficients and 8 eq_weights

gamma_consistency_opening.index_distribution: uniform i in [0,131072), mapped to even initial-tree leaf 2*i

goldilocks.scope:
Exact local WHIR budgets with the tensor-fold bridge; exploratory search is separate.
Requires the manuscript finite-certificate engine. Models ideal uniform field challenges;
actual Goldilocks challenge codec has negligible statistical distance (see protocol audit).
No claim of global query optimality or complete Fiat-Shamir security reduction.
